peer_review_model.notes: Double-anonymized peer review is available at all Nature Portfolio journals. Transparent peer review is also offered, where elements of the peer-review process are published alongside the article.

ai_use_policy.value: Peer reviewers should not upload manuscripts into generative AI tools. If any part of the evaluation of the claims made in the manuscript was supported by an AI tool, peer reviewers must declare the use of such tools transparently in the peer review report.

remarks: No article processing charges or publication fees are mentioned in the provided text, but this information may be available elsewhere on the website.
